title: Monoidal equations for the canonical cochain pullback comparison
statement:
Let R and S be sheaves of commutative rings on two small sites, f a ringed pullback and k its normalized ordinary tensor comparison as in [def-pur-cochain-tensor-coherence-data]. Write F=pull(f) for termwise pullback of integer-indexed cochain complexes, c(P,Q)=comparison(f,k,P,Q), and j=unit(f,k). The tensor is direct-sum total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], with its usual associator alpha, Koszul braiding beta, and left and right action unitors lambda,rho, built from the sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For all possibly unbounded R-complexes P,Q,H, the comparison is natural in both arguments and the following four monoidal equations hold (a semicolon denotes composition in order of application):
$$F(\alpha_{P,Q,H});c(P,Q\otimes H);(1\otimes c(Q,H))=c(P\otimes Q,H);(c(P,Q)\otimes1);\alpha_{FP,FQ,FH},$$
$$F(\beta_{P,Q});c(Q,P)=c(P,Q);\beta_{FP,FQ},$$
$$F(\lambda_P)=c(R[0],P);(j\otimes1);\lambda_{FP},\qquad F(\rho_P)=c(P,R[0]);(1\otimes j);\rho_{FP}.$$
All isomorphisms in these equations mean their forward morphisms of complexes. No flatness or boundedness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use the ordinary module associativity and symmetry equations of lem-pur-module-tensor-monoidal-equations. The canonical unit theorem supplies the right unit equation; derive the left unit equation by braiding naturality and the relation between the braiding and the right unitor. Assemble an oplax monoidal structure on f.L and use the invertible tensor and unit maps to make it monoidal. Its coproduct-preserving additive lift to cochain complexes is the source library mapCochainComplexMonoidal. Identify its tensorator with comparison on each bidegree inclusion by cancelling the inverse total comparison, and identify its unit by the single-complex map. Generic oplax associativity and unit identities give three equations. For symmetry use coproduct extensionality, the signed braiding formula and ordinary symmetry, with additivity preserving the integer sign. The same generic oplax naturality equation supplies naturality in both complex arguments, yielding the full IsCoherent conjunction.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof using the existing generic monoidal lift, identifying its total tensorator, and checking Koszul braiding on summands. Its ordinary module equations are proved in this delivery.
